text: Figure 2.1: Inner Priority Inversion "If only a single transmit buffer is used inner priority inversion may occur. Because of low priority a message stored in the buffer waits until the ”traffic on the bus calms down”. During the waiting time this message could prevent a message of higher priority generated by the same microcontroller from being transmitted over the bus." 1 1Picture and text by CiA (CAN in Automation)
